title: Skin booster injections in Cairo
description: Read about injectable skin boosters in Cairo, how hydration treatments differ from filler, what to expect after injections and when to review your skin.
answer: Skin boosters place small amounts of a chosen injectable product within the skin to address hydration or texture. Adults with dryness or fine surface changes can discuss options at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. The consultation reviews skincare, previous injections and whether a simpler routine might address the concern.
preparation: We assess your skin, review previous treatments and discuss the proposed product.
howPerformed: Skin boosters place small amounts of a product, often based on hyaluronic acid, within the skin. They are used to address hydration and texture. The ingredients and injection method depend on the product chosen.
followup: Small bumps, redness, swelling or bruising can occur at the injection sites. We will explain how long these may take to settle and give you advice on makeup, exercise and skincare afterwards.
suitability: Boosters may be considered for dryness, dullness or fine texture changes. A consultation helps us check suitability and discuss whether skincare or another treatment would be a better starting point.
outlook: Changes in hydration and texture may develop over the following weeks. The timing and extent depend on the product, treatment area and your response.

faqs.q: How are skin boosters different from filler?
faqs.a: Filler is usually used to add volume or shape in a specific area. Skin boosters are used more broadly for hydration and texture. The product and technique matter, so we will explain what the proposed treatment is intended to do.

faqs.q: When will I see the result?
faqs.a: Changes may appear gradually over the first few weeks. We will discuss the expected timing for your product and review your response before planning further sessions.
Depending on the product and your assessment, areas may include the face, neck, upper chest or hands. Ask about the specific area you would like to treat.
Discomfort varies with the area and method. Describe any previous sensitivity so that suitable comfort measures and pauses can be discussed.

faqs.q: How many visits might I need?
faqs.a: 2 to 3 sessions (with maintenance discussed at review)

faqs.q: Can I go back to my usual routine afterwards?
faqs.a: Small bumps, redness, swelling or bruising can occur at the injection sites. We will explain how long these may take to settle and give you advice on makeup, exercise and skincare afterwards.

faqs.q: Can I have treatment if my skin marks easily?
faqs.a: A history of prolonged irritation or dark marks affects planning. Tell the team how your skin healed after previous procedures so the method and timing can be assessed.
Yes. The assessment is individual and takes account of your medical history, goals and the area of concern.
The skin booster chosen, amount and treatment areas influence the cost of the course. Ask the branch on WhatsApp about the plan and review visits.

risks: Infection or vascular injury can occur with injections. Contact urgent medical services for severe pain, skin colour changes or visual symptoms.
